title: Immunosuppressants: calcineurin, antimetabolites, biologics and JAK

steps.tx: **Ciclosporin** (calcineurin IL2, **hirsutism with gum hyperplasia**, hypertension, **nephrotoxicity**, gout, **grapefruit**; levels trough) with **tacrolimus** (**tremor, diabetes**, less cosmetic, alopecia, **topical eczema** steroid sparing) anchors transplant; magnesium wasting seizes while infection and PTLD watch. CYP3A4 macrolides and azoles magnify; levels dose.

steps.tx: **Sirolimus and everolimus** (mTOR, **mouth ulcers**, hyperlipids, **pneumonitis**, **poor wound healing** surgery held, proteinuria) with **MMF** (**teratogenic** two contraceptions, GI diarrhoea, **BK virus** nephropathy, leucopenia) and **azathioprine** (**TPMT** screened, hepatotoxic, pancreatitis, **NMSC** sun) antimetabolise; allopurinol magnifies azathioprine quartering. Vaccines live banned; skin cancers screen.

steps.tx: **Steroids** (rejection pulses, diabetes, bones, infection) with **basiliximab** (IL2R induction, gentle) and **ATG** (**cytokine release** fevers, **serum sickness** weeks, PTLD, platelets) induct; **belatacept** (costimulation, **PTLD EBV naive banned**, nephron sparing) converts. steps.tx: **JAK** (**tofacitinib**: **clots with zoster**, lipids, diverticular perforation) with **anti-TNF** (**infliximab**: **TB reactivation screened**, infusion reactions, **demyelination with heart failure banned**, psoriasis paradoxical) and **rituximab** (**HBV reactivation screened**, **PML** rare, infusion cytokine, hypogammaglobulinaemia) biologics; **abatacept, tocilizumab** (lipids, bowel perforation) options. Chest X-ray with quantiferon precedes anti-TNF; HBV prophylaxis rituximab.
steps.say: Clotting shingles is tofacitinib; TB screens infliximab failing hearts demyelinated banned. HBV screens rituximab PML.
